method: Full source bodies through GitHub MCP; bounded local rereads of exact materializations; no test execution during reading.

coverage.root: All pack top-level metadata, write_authority/allocation/workflow/completion/selection/criterion and source receipt indexes; full WP07 task/axiom/edge requirements; COMMON/mission/AGENTS/START/WORKFLOW.
coverage.agenda_backend: All 17 contracts; entire resident/profile/skills/packs/routes/aliases/integrated AM sections; resident_ui, gates and interfaces; both mandatory appendices; all canonical domain sources used by implementation.
coverage.agenda_proof: All 86 proof_bindings; evidence, execution_proofs AM01-AM06, numeric_oracles, dependency_context, coverage, handoffs, consumer edges, code_sources; full mandatory appendices and runtime/reports.ts, parity-reports.test.ts, reports-runtime.test.ts.

agents: Root AGENTS applies to CLI/product/test. Applicable app-shell/e2e AGENTS and required Playwright guides read by agenda_proof. MCP absence checked for additional CLI/product ancestors.
hash_note: READ-LEDGER.json labels local materialization hashes separately from fetched remote blobs. Some scratch reads contain an extra terminal LF; consumable patch manifests prove exact remote preimages and normalized complete postimages.
